resources.string: Enable the app’s call account so that incoming calls appear in the system phone app
Copy the Firebase token for sending push notifications

Red: critically important permission for all calls and app functionality.

Blue: important permission for system-managed call integration.

Gray: standard permission, app features may work partially or limited without it.
Open new windows while running in the background
On some devices (e.g., Xiaomi), calls may not work unless “Show on lock screen” and “Allow opening windows from background” are enabled.
